Soccer America’s MLS Guide (Summer Market)

by Paul KennedySeptember 9, 2026September 9, 2026

Share this:

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X

MLS’s summer transfer window closed on Sept. 2.

It was MLS’s last summer window as the league’s secondary market. It will adopt its new calendar in 2027-28 when teams will rebuild during the summer (offseason).

Between now and then, MLS owners are expected to adopt some version of MLS 3.0, giving teams more flexibility in how they spend, if not bigger budgets.

MLS Team of the Matchday starters (summer signings)
Matchday 17: Kai Wagner (PHI), Antoine Griezmann (ORL).
Matchday 18: —
Matchday 19: Kai Wagner (PHI), Mijahir Jiménez (RBNY), *Robert Lewandowski (CHI).
Matchday 20: Elias Saad (NSH), Niklas Dorsch (TOR).
Matchday 21: Jack Harrison (NE)
Matchday 22: *Antoine Griezmann (ORL)
Matchday 23: Casemiro (MIA), Allan Saint-Maximin (CLT), Antoine Griezmann (ORL), Dejan Joveljić (SEA).
Matchday 24: *Vincent Janssen (POR).
*Player of the Matchday.

Notes:
• GAM figures do not reflect spending since opening day.
• MLS trades often include non-cash exchanges (draft picks and International Player slots).
⭐=Best XI selections.
